title: Calf Stroking
summary: The palms glide upward over the calf without pressing on the Achilles tendon or behind the knee.
startingPosition: The leg is relaxed and the foot supported.
instructions: Do not press behind the knee.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
